name: Jelly Belly
description: The iconic Jelly Belly brand was originally known as 'Goelitz Confectionery Company' before changing its name in 1976.

name: First Bean
description: The first Jelly Belly jelly bean was created in 1918 and was called 'Jelly Belly.'

name: Presidents
description: Jelly Belly jelly beans have been a favorite of presidents for decades, including Ronald Reagan who had a famous love for them.

name: Flavors
description: Jelly Belly offers over 100 different flavors, and new flavors are being introduced all the time.
